docstring:
The conjecture holds when `G` acts by isometries on a Riemannian manifold, since `G`
embeds as a closed subgroup of the isometry group, which is a Lie group by Myers–Steenrod.
type_pretty:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] {n : ℕ} {X : Type u_2} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace X]
  [T2Space X] [ConnectedSpace X] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) X] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [inst_8 : MulAction G X] [ContinuousSMul G X] [FaithfulSMul G X] [inst_11 : MetricSpace X]
  [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (↑⊤) X],
  (∀ (g : G), Isometry fun x => g • x) → Hilbert5.AdmitsLieGroupStructure G
